panels.description: Billed traffic this calendar month (in + out on the public interface: eth0 on ucpin and multicomm .246, ens3 on ucdemo and multicomm .244) against each VPS plan's monthly quota. Matches the provider panel within ~1%. Quotas are set in the queries (Quota column); update them if a plan changes. Projected = usage at the current rate by month end. October 2026 only: Used includes a fixed per-server offset for traffic before Prometheus collected ucpin11/12/13 and uc11/12 (calibrated to the provider panel at 2026-10-15 08:00 UTC); it switches off automatically on 2026-11-01 (the 1793491200 cutoff in the queries) and can then be deleted. Data coverage = share of this month that Prometheus actually has for the server; below 95% (orange) Used is lower than the provider figure because traffic before collection started cannot be counted. Needs Prometheus retention of 31d+.
